extensions.Description: Returns true when the value is a structurally valid Polish NIP (ten digits, mod-11 check digit). Makes no network call.
extensions.Name: Nip.IsValid

extensions.Description: Returns why a value is not a valid Polish NIP: VALID, EMPTY, LENGTH, NONDIGIT or CHECKSUM. Register as a text rule and set Mode = Reason. Makes no network call.
extensions.Name: Nip.Validate
